source: Observed on the live Dock 'Linear server' tab after a cmux relaunch to 0.65.1, 2026-10-14 (read-screen, env, cmux identify --json, restore with explicit id)
statement: In cmux 0.65.1 a resume binding with auto_resume true on a global Dock terminal does not restart its command after a cmux relaunch: cmux types `cmux restore --surface` without an id into the restored shell, whose CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID is the window id (not a listed workspace), so `cmux identify` reports caller null and restore fails with 'the current cmux surface could not be identified'. `cmux restore --surface "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID"` in that tab works and keeps the binding.
